children: Veradigm disclosed a presentation outlining a 2025 revenue estimate of $584–589 million and plans to relist shares once SEC filings are current.
Presented investor deck at Jefferies and Deutsche Bank conferences; deck furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and reusable at other conferences.
Estimated 2025 revenue of $584–589M and reported $120M cash and $75M debt at year-end 2025.
Transformation strategy "Reset, Recover, Reignite" aims to accelerate growth and improve profitability beginning in 2026.
Company recently filed 2023 and 2024 10-Ks; 2025 audit underway and expects a 10-K filing later in 2026 and relisting once current.
Emphasizes Health Network Architecture, AI capabilities, and focus on providers, payers, and life sciences to drive cross-sell and data monetization.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Veradigm to present investor deck, discloses 2025 revenue estimate $584–589M and relisting plans
